title: Silverware
description: A project based on curiosities of form and material, attempting elegant silverware through simple and cost-effective manufacturing.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: Elegant silverware through simple, cost-effective manufacturing.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: The knife, fork and spoon each read as one folded, twisting surface of steel.

study_intro: Elegance from simple manufacture: each piece is one surface, folded and twisted.

study.label: Form
study.text: Knife, fork and spoon each read as a single ribbon of steel that twists from handle to head, with no separate handle.

study.label: Finish
study.text: Mirror chrome that picks up color from the table, set on a bold patterned cloth in the hero image.

study.label: Proportion
study.text: Long, tapering silhouettes, so the set reads as one family.
